units.source_text: 这时刻多么不适宜于纵火。

en.t: What an unsuitable time this was for setting a fire.

units.source_text: 一只迷途在柏油马路上飞舞的蝴蝶，翩翩翻翻地围绕着香烟铺前播在小花瓶里的衰萎了的山茶花。

en.t: A butterfly that had lost its way and was fluttering over the asphalt road circled lightly around the withered camellias arranged in a small vase in front of the tobacco shop.

units.source_text: 白山东花枯萎的部分是茶褐色，如同被火燎后一样。

en.t: The withered parts of the white camellia were tea-brown, as though they had been scorched by fire.

units.source_text: 公共汽车总也不到站，马路上的时间停滞了。

en.t: The bus never seemed to arrive at the stop, and time on the road had come to a standstill.
